notices.title: Batman Arkham City - 15 Years Later
notices.contentSnippet: Batman: Arkham changed the AAA landscape by proving licensed games could stand beside some of the best gaming had to offer. Batman: Arkham City leveled things up offering a revolutionary Batman experience that has built a legacy of prestige since it released in 2011. There have been countless games released since that build on the foundation of Arkham City, try and use its fundamentals to make new superhero games, but none have dethroned the dark knight. Why do we keep coming back to Batman: Arkham City?
